title: Open chat and get an answer to a first question
description: A visitor can open the chat from the homepage, ask a first question, and receive an AI response in the same conversation.

steps.description: Fill in the chat input with a college-related question
Verify the chat conversation shows the user's question
Verify an AI response is displayed in the chat history

title: Continue a chat with a follow-up question
description: A visitor can ask a follow-up question in the same open chat thread and see the conversation continue with another relevant AI response.

steps.description: Fill in the chat input with an initial college-related question
Fill in the chat input with a follow-up question
Verify both user messages remain visible in the chat history
Verify multiple AI responses are displayed in the same conversation

title: Browse the homepage college information
description: A visitor can scroll through the landing page and view the college information sections on the single public page.

steps.description: Verify the homepage college information sections are displayed
Verify the landing page remains usable without opening chat

title: See validation for an empty chat message
description: A visitor who tries to send an empty chat message sees validation and no message is added to the conversation.

steps.description: Submit the chat message without entering text
Verify an input validation message is displayed
Verify no new chat message was added

title: Send a chat message with Enter
description: A visitor can send a valid chat message by pressing Enter and see the message appear in the conversation.

steps.description: Fill in the chat input with a college-related question
Verify the chat conversation shows the user's message
Verify an AI response is displayed in the chat history

title: Reopen the chat drawer and keep the conversation visible
description: A visitor can close and reopen the chat drawer from the floating button and still see the prior conversation.

steps.description: Fill in the chat input with a college-related question
Verify the prior chat messages are still visible
Verify the chat remains ready for another message

title: Keep browsing the homepage without opening chat
description: A visitor can interact with the landing page content only and the single-page experience remains usable without using the chat drawer.

steps.description: Verify the homepage information sections are displayed
Verify the chat drawer is not open
